args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665` was rounding up to `2.67` instead of to-even `2.66`).

## Change
- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `src/money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch: **passed**.

Please review and approve to merge into main.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
